notes: Only dashboard/final-example is in scope; the repo's other examples are not.
(overview) is a route group, so app/dashboard/(overview)/page.tsx serves /dashboard.
There are no route handlers (app/**/route.ts) at this commit, so there are no endpoints.
Server actions in app/lib/actions.ts (createInvoice, updateInvoice, deleteInvoice, authenticate) are UI actions, not pages or endpoints.
Not pages: layout.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, favicon.ico and opengraph-image.png.
